svg.aria-label: A loop of two resistors around a changing flux: a voltmeter on the left reads plus 0.1 volt and one on the right reads minus 0.9 volt across the same two nodes, because the induced field makes the reading depend on the path
svg.text: With a changing flux inside, "the voltage between A and B" depends on the path

text.tspan: Path-dependent voltage — the induced electric field is not conservative
